en: A vintage colored illustration titled in French and Ottoman Turkish showing four Ottoman-era men in traditional dress, walking in a line from left to right. They wear turbans, fezzes and baggy trousers, and carry musical instruments, bundles, or pipes. The style resembles a 19th‑ or early‑20th‑century 'collection of costumes' ethnographic postcard. Printed captions in red at the top and in French and Ottoman script at the bottom identify the characters as "Medjmouat tesaouir (Collection de costumes)" and variants of 'Karakoulouktchou / Orta Sakkassi', with a circular seal and a Greek website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".
